_doc: Canonical offer manifest (Nov 2, 2026). Every surface (Gumroad product.json, site pages, keyword replies, emails, queued posts) must match this. tests/test_manifest.py enforces it; scripts/growthos/health.py checks production against it hourly. Change prices here AND in products/<slug>/product.json, only with Seb's approval. Also the Master Plan's config/products.json: one place for names, prices, Gumroad ids, truthful claims (what_it_is, includes, does_not, needs) and verification status.

offers.name: Front Desk Kit
offers.what_it_is: A setup kit (PDF and prompts) installed in the buyer's own Claude account. It drafts replies, quotes and follow ups; the owner reviews and sends.
includes: Setup agent and 15 question business interview
9 commands: reply, quote, chase, review, faq, plan week and more
Message templates, cheat sheet and time back tracker
offers.setup_time: about 30 minutes (our estimate; being measured in owner tests)
offers.refund: 30 day refund: reply to the Gumroad receipt
offers.verification: not yet tested end to end by an outside buyer
offers.advertise: hold until 3 owner usability tests pass
does_not: send messages, texts or emails by itself
connect to your phone, text messages, Google Business or booking software
work without you reviewing each draft
needs: about 30 minutes to answer the setup interview (estimate, being measured)
your real prices, hours and rules

pilots.name: Front Desk Setup (done for you)
pilots.status: pilot: not on sale, no checkout yet. Offered only in approved 1:1 outreach after a delivery test
pilots.what_it_is: We configure the Front Desk Kit for one business: intake of their real services, prices and rules, quote templates, a test of the reply workflow on their real messages, and a handoff call. Runs in the owner's own Claude account. The owner reviews and sends every message.
includes: Intake form for services, prices, hours and rules
Business Brain written and checked with the owner
Quote and follow up templates for their services
Test on 5 of their real recent customer messages
does_not: send messages, texts or emails by itself
answer customers 24/7 or connect to their phone, booking or social inboxes
